dish.title: Portuguese Piri-Piri Roast Chicken with Rice and Tomato Salad
dish.description: A spatchcocked whole chicken marinated in a fiery blended piri-piri sauce of red chiles, garlic, smoked paprika, lemon, and vinegar, then high-heat roasted until the skin is blistered and burnished. Served with onion rice and a sharp tomato and red-onion salad.

recipe_version.title: Portuguese Piri-Piri Roast Chicken with Rice and Tomato Salad
recipe_version.description: A spatchcocked whole chicken marinated in a fiery blended piri-piri sauce of red chiles, garlic, smoked paprika, lemon, and vinegar, then high-heat roasted until the skin is blistered and burnished. Served with onion rice and a sharp tomato and red-onion salad.

ingredients.name: extra-virgin olive oil
ingredients.note: 1/4 cup sauce, 2 tbsp rice, 2 tbsp salad

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.note: 2 tsp chicken, 1/2 tsp rice, 1/2 tsp salad

steps.title: Preheat, spatchcock, and blend
steps.body: Turn the oven on to 425 F to preheat with a rack in the upper-middle; it heats through the marinade. Cut out the chicken's backbone with poultry shears, flip it, and press firmly on the breastbone to flatten. Pat dry and season all over with 2 tsp salt. Blend the Fresno and bird's eye chiles, garlic, smoked paprika, lemon juice, 2 tbsp vinegar, oregano, and 1/4 cup olive oil until smooth. Set aside 1/4 cup of the sauce for serving.

steps.title: Marinate
steps.body: Rub the rest of the sauce all over and under the skin of the chicken and let it sit at room temperature 30 minutes on the rack set in the sheet pan, skin side up.

steps.title: Roast
steps.body: Roast in the preheated 425 F oven until the skin is deep bronze with charred spots, the thigh reads 175 F, and the breast reads 160 F, 40 to 45 minutes.

steps.title: Rest
steps.body: Rest the chicken 10 minutes, then cut into pieces.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.body: During the roast, heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a 2-quart saucepan over medium, cook the diced onion 4 minutes, then add the rice, 2 1/4 cups water, and 1/2 tsp salt. Boil, cover, cook on low 15 minutes, and rest covered 10. Runs inside step 3 (overlap stated).

steps.title: Make the salad and serve
steps.body: During the rest, toss the tomatoes and red onion with 1 tbsp vinegar, 2 tbsp olive oil, 1/2 tsp salt, and the parsley (overlap stated: inside step 4). Serve the chicken with the rice, salad, lemon wedges, and the reserved sauce.

equipment: rimmed sheet pan with a wire rack
